# Global Multilingual Content Provider

Geography

Global content operations across multiple regions and languages

Compliance-Ready Content Delivery- Global Multilingual Content Provider

- Large inventory of PDFs and EPUBs required remediation to meet WCAG and international accessibility standards.
- Multilingual content introduced complexity in tagging, navigation, and screen-reader compatibility.
- Increasing global distribution requirements mandated compliance-ready formats.

### Our Approach

Assessed the client's existing content to identify gaps in structure, tagging, language handling, and navigation.

Converted PDFs and EPUBs into fully WCAG-compliant accessible formats using standardized tagging and semantic structuring.

Implemented a streamlined production workflow with automated checks and manual validation for accuracy.

Ensured multilingual content support through correct language tagging, reading order, headings, alt text, and metadata.

- Delivered WCAG-compliant PDFs and accessible EPUBs across multiple languages.
- Enabled on-time academic readiness, mitigating compliance and delivery risks.
- Built a repeatable, scalable remediation model that the client can use for future content modernization.
